extensionDescription.message: Select a region, keep interacting with the live page, and capture the exact moment as a local PNG.

popupGenericError.message: The action could not be completed.

popupConnectionError.message: Could not connect to the current page.

popupHelpSelect.message: Click an element or drag a custom region.

popupHelpInteract.message: Keep using the live page after the region locks.

popupHelpCapture.message: Capture from the overlay, popup, Enter, or the shortcut.

overlayTextHint.message: Click to add text, or on a note to change it; drag a note to move it. Enter keeps it, Shift+Enter adds a line, Esc cancels.

overlayStepHint.message: Click to drop numbered steps: 1, 2, 3… Undo removes the last.

overlayMarkHint.message: Drag inside the region to draw. Esc returns to the page.

overlaySelectHint.message: Click an element or drag to select a region

overlayTooSmall.message: That region is too small. Try again.

overlayLockedHint.message: Region locked — keep interacting with the page

overlaySelectFirst.message: Select and lock a region first

overlayPngError.message: Could not create the image file.

overlayCaptureMissing.message: Chrome did not return a screenshot.

overlayCopyFallback.message: This page blocks the clipboard — image saved instead

overlayFullPageTruncated.message: The page is too long for one image — the first part was saved

overlayFullPageCopiedTruncated.message: The page is too long for one image — the first part was copied

overlayScrollCapture.message: Capture the whole scrolling panel or tall element under the region

overlayScrollNothing.message: Nothing to scroll here: no scrolling panel and nothing taller than the window

overlayScrollTruncated.message: Too tall for one image — the first part was saved

overlayScrollCopiedTruncated.message: Too tall for one image — the first part was copied

overlayScrollPartial.message: Part of the area never came on screen, so the image has only what scrolling could reach

errorRestricted.message: Chrome does not allow Region Snap to run on this page.

errorInvalidUrl.message: The current tab address is invalid.

errorUnsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be captured. Try a regular website.

errorNoSelection.message: No region has been selected on this tab.

errorUnknownCaptureTab.message: Could not identify the tab to capture.

errorTabChanged.message: The active tab changed before the screenshot was captured.

errorNoLockedRegion.message: No region is locked on this tab.

optionsFormatHint.message: Copying to the clipboard always uses PNG. JPEG has no transparency, so cut corners are white.

optionsActionHint.message: Used by Enter, the keyboard shortcut and the popup. The toolbar buttons always do what they say.

optionsDelayHint.message: Counts down before a region is captured, so you can open a menu or hover first. Esc stops the countdown. A full-page capture starts at once.

overlayBurst.message: Burst: take several shots in a row

overlayWatch.message: Capture each time the region changes

overlayWatchArmed.message: Watching — each change is saved, up to $COUNT$ images. Esc stops.

optionsBurstHint.message: The burst button in the toolbar takes this many shots of the region, each saved as its own numbered file. Chrome may ask once to allow several downloads from the site.

optionsWatchHint.message: While watching, the region is saved each time its content changes, up to this many shots. The toolbar button or Esc stops it sooner.
